title: HydroPulse v2.1.7 - <300ms Motor Latency, State Memory, Watchdog & Notification Enforcement
changelog: Sub-300ms Motor Control: Pump start/stop is visually instant with 3000ms anti-flap lock window.
Hardware State Memory: Motor state and mode persisted in SharedPreferences; restored on reconnect.
Manual/Auto Mode Fix: 3000ms optimistic lock prevents mode flapping from stale MQTT packets.
Offline Flash Fix: Refresh preserves live MQTT heartbeat — no more false OFFLINE flashes.
Fresh Login Provisioning: New accounts see hardware pairing flow, not phantom devices.
Notification Enforcement: Alerts strictly respect user notification settings toggles.
Command Notifications Removed: No more 'Motor Started' or 'command sent' SnackBars on user actions.
Backend 300ms Watchdog: Cloud evaluates hardware online status every 300ms proactively.
